about: What 'the fake matches the live service' means. Every top-level field of a parity record must be listed in exact or shapeOnly; a field listed in neither fails the comparison, so a new field can never be ignored silently. resultFieldClasses decides which response leaves are compared by shape (present, same JSON type) instead of by value; every other leaf is compared by name and type through resultFields.

exact.status: the HTTP status, or null for a client-side refusal
exact.errorClass: the SDK error class (lib/errors.mjs errorClassFor), or null on success
exact.code: the typed error code, or null on success
exact.resultFields: every response leaf's dotted path and JSON type (values are not compared here)
exact.fileContent: file contents written and read back
exact.stateSequence: the lifecycle states a resource passed through, in order
exact.eventTypes: the sequence of stream event types, consecutive duplicates collapsed
exact.deltaText: the concatenated message_delta text of a run

shapeOnly.idempotencyKey: the key a call was sent with
shapeOnly.ids: resource ids found in the response (resultFieldClasses.ids)
shapeOnly.sizes: byte counts and sizes that depend on timing or encoding (resultFieldClasses.sizes)
shapeOnly.hashes: content addresses, digests and audit hashes (resultFieldClasses.hashes)
